The fog bank moves at a constant speed, covering 3 miles every 10 minutes. The city extends 42 miles from the oceanfront to the inland edge. To find the total time, we can determine how many 3-mile segments are in 42 miles, and multiply by the time per segment.

42 miles ÷ 3 miles = 14 segments
14 segments × 10 minutes = 140 minutes

Answer: 140
